prompt: The actor known for playing Kenny "Shammy" Shamberg in Magnum P.I. was born how days before the Apollo 11 moon landing?
answer: Christopher Thornton was born on **March 29, 1967**. Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on **July 20, 1969**, which was **844 days later**—so he was born **844 days before** the landing.
